import selfies as sf
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from pyscf import gto, dft
s='[C][C][Branch1][Ring2][C][C][O][C][C][C][#C]'

m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=17
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)==0
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
coords=m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
atoms=[(a.GetSymbol(),tuple(coords[a.GetIdx()])) for a in m.GetAtoms()]
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms,basis='6-31g*',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
ks=dft.RKS(mol); ks.xc='b3lyp'; ks.conv_tol=1e-9; ks.max_cycle=100

print('SELFIES:',s)
print('SMILES:',sm)
print('Canonical SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('Method: gas-phase B3LYP/6-31G* single point on RDKit ETKDG/MMFF94s conformer')

print('HOMO energy (Ha):',float(ks.mo_energy[int(occ[-1])]))
